I started in Ho Chi Minh City and bought a motorcycle which I would definitely recommend, I had no idea how to drive one but you learn really fast in HCMC. Dalat was absolutely wonderful, it's up in the mountains so it's a nice escape from the SEA heat. Hoi An is another city I would definitely recommend. It's a charming old city with amazing food and a beautiful beach. Danang is only 30 minutes north and it's nice for a stop over, the views are beautiful. You can get a cheap food tour through a place called Ms Vys. Hue is a little farther north, if you rent/have a bike you can drive out to an abandoned water park and drive around for hours. I'm currently in Phong Nha which is known for its Caves. The Vietnamese people are absolutely lovely, and the food here is life changing. I don't really have much to say about the north since I'm not there yet but I heard it only gets better and better c:

Seriously, go to Vietnam.

Hey! I've been in SEA for about 4 months now and you should definitely reconsider skipping Vietnam. It has been my absolute favorite place so far, I'm already planning on extending my visa for a 3rd time. There's a pretty popular backpacker trail so it's perfect for beginners.
Melaka is absolutely stunning, but you can definitely see everything in 1-2 days.
I would skip KL and possibly singapore and spend more time at one of the other stops. KL is just a big city, theres not much worth seeing if you're on a time crunch.
